panels.description: Number of named process groups currently being monitored.
panels.title: Total Process Groups

panels.description: Total number of individual processes across all groups.
panels.title: Total Processes

panels.description: Aggregate CPU usage across all monitored process groups.
panels.title: Total CPU (millicores)

panels.description: Aggregate resident memory across all monitored process groups.
panels.title: Total Resident Memory

targets.expr: topk($topN, (sum(irate(namedprocess_namegroup_cpu_seconds_total{instance=~"$host", groupname=~"$groupname", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) by (groupname) > 0) / scalar(count(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="$server:$port_node_exporter", job="$job_node_exporter"}) by (cpu))))

panels.description: Resident memory as a percentage of total system RAM, per process group.

targets.expr: topk($topN, namedprocess_namegroup_memory_bytes{instance=~"$host", groupname=~"$groupname", memtype="resident", job="$job"} / ignoring(memtype) namedprocess_namegroup_num_procs / scalar(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{instance="$server:$port_node_exporter", job="$job_node_exporter"}))

panels.title: Resident Memory % of RAM

targets.expr: topk($topN, namedprocess_namegroup_memory_bytes{instance=~"$host", groupname=~"$groupname", memtype="resident", job="$job"} / ignoring(memtype) namedprocess_namegroup_num_procs > 0)

panels.description: Total amount of memory that may be required by the process.

targets.expr: topk($topN, namedprocess_namegroup_memory_bytes{instance=~"$host", groupname=~"$groupname", memtype="virtual", job="$job"} / ignoring(memtype) namedprocess_namegroup_num_procs > 0)
